answer: In our network, each node anchors its identity in a cryptographic attestation chain verified through zero-knowledge proofs. To deter swarms, consensus requires staking tiered bonds that scale exponentially: the cost to spin up n identities scales as O(2^n). This creates a financial haven that repels malicious entities. Like carving rules into basalt, this foundation turns sable attacker swarms away by imposing rapid capital exhaustion.
